content: Maintaining near-normal glycemic control is critically important for delaying or preventing the onset of diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) and cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy (CAN) in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Although the evidence is less robust for individuals with type 2 diabetes, certain studies suggest that intensive glucose control may modestly slow the progression of neuropathy in this population. Additionally, effective blood pressure management has demonstrated benefits in reducing the risk of developing both DPN and CAN.
